note: THE-344 retires the PENDING_DODO_REPRICE record THE-343 left behind. THE-343 repriced Ministry to 60/162/564 in PLAN_PRICING and could not touch Dodo, whose products are edited by hand, so it recorded the gap in a second table beside the live fixture and excluded the three Ministry rows from the catalogue suite's strict equality check. The three live products have since been repriced: THE-344 read all nine live products back from the authenticated Dodo API with products.retrieve before changing a line, and confirmed Harvest Ministry Monthly (pdt_0NlJZMUUiT36FGMoiFXgl) at 6000, Quarterly (pdt_0NloCatUWEkEUq1usWJ0n) at 16200 and Annual (pdt_0NlJZMXTnpRBAwTfBVpPs) at 56400, each with trial_period_days 14, trial_type free, currency USD, tax_inclusive false, tax_category saas and its billing frequency (1 Month, 3 Month, 1 Year) intact - the trial being the field products.update silently wipes because it replaces the whole price object. The six Individual and Small Team products were re-read in the same pass and had not moved, so plus and pro are untouched and no price in plan-features.ts changed: this ticket moves a TEST FIXTURE, not a price. Recorded plainly, because it changes what the ticket was: the divergence record could NEVER have self-alerted. Its docblock promised that the day the founder updated the products those assertions would fail, but both halves of every such assertion were fixture literals in the same file, so it compared a transcription against a transcription and stayed green whatever Dodo did - main was fully green at baseline (456 files, 12354 passed, 1 todo, exit 0) with all three products already repriced. Also recorded: the ticket described ONE file carrying the record and there were THREE. Besides dodo-catalogue.test.ts, the-248-discount-alignment.test.ts carried its own PENDING_DODO_REPRICE and a LIVE_DODO_USD.max row of 80/216/760, and the-343-ministry-reprice.test.ts carried a PENDING table of 8000/21600/76000 and a describe block titled for a reprice the founder had not yet made; dodo-quarterly-term.test.ts and the-222-repricing.test.ts carried the claim in prose only. All five are corrected. NO firestore.rules digest is recorded here, deliberately and emphatically: this ticket does not go near that file, and THE-333 and THE-341 each recording one is what turned THE-325 red twice. THE-344 adds no rules pinner either - 62 suites already pin the file through the shared module and a 63rd would cost edits to THE-322's and THE-325's counted registers for no added protection - so PINNING_SUITES and RULES_PINNERS_NOW are both untouched. Recorded plainly, because the guard machinery caught it before review: THE-344's OWN guard docblock spelled the name of the shared rules-digest module while explaining why this ticket deliberately does not use it, and THE-325 counts pinning suites by exactly that substring - so the file registered itself as a 63rd pinner and turned three register assertions red (THE-322's population pin and two of THE-325's). It is the docblock-quotes-the-gate hazard exactly, landing on the file whose own needles are assembled at run time to avoid it, and the same shape as THE-343's tool-count docblock and THE-342's first-draft rules digest. The module is now described and never named, PINNING_SUITES and RULES_PINNERS_NOW are both untouched at 62, and the episode is left standing in that docblock rather than tidied away.

entries.why: THE-344 owns this change and it is the whole point of the ticket. The three Ministry rows of DODO_LIVE_PRODUCTS_AS_VERIFIED go from the superseded amounts to 6000/16200/56400, transcribed from a products.retrieve read of each product id rather than copied from PLAN_PRICING - which is what keeps the fixture an independent check instead of a restatement of catalogue.ts. PENDING_DODO_REPRICE is deleted outright, along with DODO_LIVE_IN_STEP (the list derived by excluding the three Ministry ids), the conditional inside the id-and-price pin that read the pending table, and the both-sides test that asserted the live and app figures must DIFFER. All three it.each blocks over live products now iterate the full nine, so the strict equality covers every product with no branch left that could weaken it, and the id-and-price pin gained a planPriceUsd assertion so each row proves the Dodo side and the app side agree in one place. The docblock is corrected: it named a divergence that no longer exists, which is the false-comfort defect this repo keeps finding. It deliberately does NOT restate the retired identifier or the retired amounts, because THE-344's own guard sweeps comments for both and a docblock that quotes the gate is how thirteen guards in this series passed a planted defect. NOTHING about test mode moved: those six products really do still predate THE-195, that divergence is real, and its fixture, its docblock and its both-sides assertion are byte-identical. The trial assertions are untouched and are now separately pinned by THE-344's suite, because trial_period_days is the field products.update wipes.

THE-344 owns this change, and this file is the one the ticket did not know about. It carried a SECOND PENDING_DODO_REPRICE - a per-term record of live versus app dollars - and a LIVE_DODO_USD.max row of 80/216/760 defended by a comment reading STILL 80/216/760, AND THAT IS THE TRUTH ON PURPOSE. It was true when written and had quietly become false. The max row is now 60/162/564, re-read from the live API in the same products.retrieve pass as every other figure here, and the pending table is deleted. The two consumers that special-cased max - the per-price check and the catalogue check, both spelled plan === 'max' ? PENDING[term].app : LIVE_DODO_USD[plan][term] - now read LIVE_DODO_USD directly for all three tiers, so the file checks all nine at full strength rather than six. The both-sides test that asserted PLAN_PRICING.max must DIFFER from the live transcription now asserts they are EQUAL; the two halves are still written independently, so that remains a real check. THE-248's own subject is untouched: the discount arithmetic, the monthly-headline contract, the plus and pro rows, the restated-price sweep and its population floor are all byte-identical, and THE-344's suite asserts that sweep is still in place rather than trusting it.

THE-344 owns this change. This is THE-343's own suite and it carried the third copy of the record: a PENDING map of live 8000/21600/76000 against app 6000/16200/56400 per term, inside a describe block titled 'the Dodo reprice the founder has NOT yet made', plus a header docblock stating that the three live products still charge the old amounts. All three claims are now false. The map is renamed MINISTRY and its live half re-transcribed from the live API, so live and app are the same figure and the test that asserted app < live now asserts app === live and additionally checks the catalogue's minor units per term - a partial update, which is the failure mode that actually matters when products.update replaces a whole price object, fails there per product. The docblock and the section banner are corrected to say the window is closed rather than open. NOTHING ELSE IN THE FILE MOVED: the discount derivation, the BEFORE table of 80/216/760 that records what the price WAS (a historical statement that is still true), the feature-matrix and cap no-regression pins, the PLATFORM_FEE_MAP check, the client-side plan-write sweep and the comment-stripped source guards are all byte-identical. THE-344 ADDS this file: the guard suite for the retirement. It sweeps every module under src/ over COMMENT-STRIPPED source for the retired identifier and for the exclusion list derived from it, and separately sweeps COMMENTS ONLY across the five files that carried the record for six present-tense claims that the gap is still open - the inverse reader, because a stale comment is invisible to a comment-stripping grep and a stale comment is what cost a whole ticket at CARTO. The live fixture is PARSED out of the catalogue suite's own array literal rather than re-typed, sliced to the live array so the deliberately stale test-mode rows above it are not read by mistake, and the row count is itself asserted. Every needle naming the retired record is assembled at run time so this file cannot satisfy its own sweep by quoting it, and every sweep asserts its own population is non-empty before asserting anything about its members - two guards in this series were vacuous because an empty slice made them trivially true. Section 0 proves both readers work, including that the // arm does not eat the code after a https:// URL. The nine live amounts are enumerated once, transcribed from the API, and checked against PLAN_PRICING, the catalogue and the fixture together. The trial is asserted twice over: that every live entry carries 14 days, and that the catalogue suite's own trial assertions still EXIST in its code, because trial_period_days is the field products.update silently wipes. No line number is pinned, no date is constructed, nothing shells out or reads a diff, and firestore.rules is deliberately not pinned - 62 suites already do through the shared module and a 63rd would cost edits to two other tickets' counted registers.
